summary: Frontend-only Stage C foundation testing completed against http://127.0.0.1:8787. Homepage raw HTML and desktop/mobile shell smoke checks passed, but the required internal route /__migration-parity is returning 404 instead of 200.

ui_bugs.issue: GET /__migration-parity returns 404 and renders not-found shell instead of internal dashboard

integration_issues.flow: Stage C internal dashboard boundary validation
integration_issues.issue: Required route summary checks (352/333/18/1/0) cannot be validated at runtime because the route is not reachable

action_items: Fix routability of /__migration-parity (currently 404 on workerd preview).

Likely RCA: app directory segment starts with underscore and is treated as private in Next App Router; rename route segment to escaped form (e.g. %5F%5Fmigration-parity) or equivalent approach that preserves URL /__migration-parity.
After route fix, revalidate 200 status, noindex directive on the actual dashboard page, dashboard data-testid, and 352/333/18/1/0 summary visibility.
critical_code_review_comments: Critical routing defect: /app/nextjs/app/__migration-parity/page.tsx is not being served at /__migration-parity in runtime; request is handled by catch-all/not-found path instead.
Maintainability risk: homepage JSX in /app/nextjs/app/page.tsx is fully minified into one line, making parity reviews and future diffs harder.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (homepage raw HTML + desktop/mobile smoke passed; parity dashboard route failed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated via pytest + direct HTTP + Playwright smoke against local OpenNext workerd URL only. Homepage checks passed: single approved H1, Engineering Brilliance, both hero CTAs visible in raw HTML and UI, canonical/title/description/JSON-LD present, crawlable links present, counters non-zero in source, no root-level 'use client' in app/page.tsx, no shell console errors on desktop/mobile (390px), and no horizontal overflow. /sitemap.xml does not include /__migration-parity. Blocking issue is /__migration-parity returning 404 at runtime.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/__migration-parity returns 404, response body includes not-found rendering markers and lacks data-testid="migration-parity-dashboard". Source file exists at /app/nextjs/app/__migration-parity/page.tsx but is not routable in runtime. Probable root cause is Next App Router private-folder semantics for underscore-prefixed segments, causing this segment to be excluded from route generation and falling through to catch-all/notFound path. Mitigation: expose the path using an escaped segment naming approach while preserving URL /__migration-parity, then rerun this scoped suite.
